objectives.text: Name the stages of a plant life cycle: seed, seedling, adult plant, flower, new seeds, and name the stages of a butterfly life cycle: egg, caterpillar, pupa, adult butterfly
successCriteria: I can name the plant stages in order: seed, seedling, adult plant, flower, new seeds
I can name the butterfly stages in order: egg, caterpillar, pupa, adult butterfly
assessmentPoints: Stage-naming answers in the opening activity
Butterfly-order answers in the third and fourth activities

objectives.text: Explain how new seeds forming inside a flower start the plant cycle again, and explain why the flower is not the end of the life of the plant
successCriteria: I can explain that new seeds form inside the flower and start the cycle again
I can explain that the flower is not the end because those new seeds fall to the soil and sprout
assessmentPoints: Trap discussion in the second activity
Worksheet and exit ticket answers in the closing practice

activities.title: A seed wakes up and sprouts
Watch out: the flower is not the end of the plant
An egg hatches into a caterpillar

differentiation.support: Provide a simple seed-to-flower cycle diagram with arrows so learners can follow one seed round the whole cycle before naming the stages themselves.

activities.title: The butterfly emerges and the cycle repeats

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to explain why the new seeds inside the flower prove the flower is not the end of the life of the plant.
